description.en: Moves a low-detail cutscene character model along a 3-point path, by delegating straight to CMND_CHR_PATH_SETUP. One of a family (EvLowMdlSetPath3..EvLowMdlSetPath8) differing only by how many path points they accept.
Handle of the character model to move.
Turn/facing behavior while following the path.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Move a character along a 3-point path
EvLowMdlSetPath3(hCharaL, 5.0, 1, [0, 0, 0], [50, 0, 0], [50, 0, 50]);
